blindness.limitations: This is a fresh delegated AI visual inspection, not a human inspection or independent ground truth. No external geospatial ground truth was consulted.

method.source: Only the twelve raw PNG previews, manifest spatial bounds/CRS/zone geometry and identity metadata, with review_intake projection helper read as reference.
method.image_inspection: Every raw preview opened with view_image; native crops enlarged using nearest-neighbor for reading, with static zone boundaries and coordinate ticks. No image detection or pixel segmentation was executed.
method.projection: Native pixel corners mapped linearly into native asset bounds, then transformed with pyproj always_xy=True to WGS84. WGS84 bounding boxes were never stretched as a pixel grid.
method.pixel_rectangle_convention: [left, top, right, bottom] in native raw-preview pixel-edge coordinates, origin at top left; boxes mark visible candidate extent plus small reading margin.
method.candidate_semantics: Possible vessels by visible morphology only. Confidence is qualitative plausibility, not a calibrated probability. SAR returns, optical hulls and wake heads can be uncertain. Bounding-box dimensions are not vessel lengths.
method.area_semantics: Every manifest zone was visually scanned. Reviewed_area records completely inspected evaluable portions. Where the raw zone covers land, shore clutter, foam or unresolved signals, conservative water areas were delimited; an empty decision applies only to those areas.
